notes.content:

Patch notes:
--Due to multiple request in the steam community. This patch focuses on a rework of remote gripping logic to be able to deal with objects surfaces better when doing the trace. Now it will multi-trace for objects and return the first object that can be gripped doing away with some of the strange angles you would have to hold your hand at to get the object to highlight for gripping due to the surface blocking the trace. notes.title: Dev Blog #1 - In progress work, Haunted Hallway Gamemode coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi there!

It's been a while since I've posted a state of the game and let users outside of [url=https://discord.gg/sezP9RC]our discord[/url] know what we are working on and how things are coming along.

Haunted Hallway:- https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/563802459315765262/746144596538425454/2020-08-20_17-42-20.mp4

Above we have a taste of some of the work we are putting in towards a new game mode that can be played coop (2 people to start). The Mode will place you and a friend in a 3 story building with long halls of doors each needing to be visited and each with their own surprises! You'll eventually get a key to the next floor and repeat the process until you make it to the exit.

We recently added things like sounds to doors, latching, creaking, opening, snapping and sliding. These additions are part of the polish that will also make it into other game modes (Sandbox, Apoc, Etc) but really needed to be knocked out for the ambience and feeling of a horror style gamemode.

Performance:-
-performance optimizations on impact components timer. 
-(Guns, melee, etc) Checked against active state for all logic and controlled via grip release events. 
-No need to fire impact effects (dust) on gripped objects so no longer leaving the component active during held states.

Bug Fixes:-
-fixed bug where players could grip onto the leaderboard widgets and climb into 1vs1
-fixed the bug where the tablet would collide with the vehicle and op it out of the map in rare cases.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37499949/eade2c5698aff9f1746f06fc314f6cb832eb2910.png[/img]
-added a climb assist function that can be called to correct user issues with climbing ladders over obstacles.
-A ladder actor has now been made for linear levels (above situation for example) to automatically teleport you over the obstacle instead of relying on flinging or pulling your hand to your feet at the very top. 
-adjusted the "top" detection function when trying to pull yourself "onto" something. Will test this before pushing out but should make climbing "onto" normal ledges and surfaces alot easier.

Summary:
We have a lot of different things going on simultaneously in the latest build and will get each of them to a place where we are happy with the quality and the additions. This means testing that we also don't negatively affect any current core gameplay before pushing the patch. In the coming weeks we will likely be shifting some focus over to solo play, gameplay loops, progression of some type, NPC functionality expansion in apoc to give players a great experience and replay ability. We are bouncing around ideas on how to expand the sandbox experience for more "structured" choices "teams, mini modes etc" so there is a lot of feeding off the community and feedback and just adjusting as we have time to listen to everyone and see how things are coming along. Thank you again for being here with us and keep an eye out for the next patch .... shouldn't be too much longer.

Thanks,
Jason & Tim
~WildOx Studios~
~Timer Games~

notes.title: Thanks from the Devs! Preparing for Early Access!
notes.content:
We (Tim and Jason) just wanted to say thank you to everyone that's been testing, joined our discord, or  reached out through youtube or reddit as well as other mediums. I've personally found this experience gratifying to see this passion project grow into the comically engaging and overall fun sandboxy experience we have the pleasure to be bringing to you very shortly. I'd like to discuss the path forward and clarify the roadmap. A summary of what's included and what can be expected for the future!

1) The current state of the Free to play core is "Early Access"
2) The F2P core gameplay will receive minor and major updates until the end of 2021
3) The F2P core updates will include everything from additional mini games and new gamemodes, AI tweaks, bug fixes, content additions, weapon tweaks, mini game completion etc.

We hope you all see the potential and the value we are diligently attempting to bring to our playerbase.

* (F2P) Zombie-Mode is in heavy daily development and should be release within the next 2 months
* (F2P) Apoc-Mode will continue heavy development until the end of 2021.
* (F2P) Missions will continue heavy development until the end of 2021.

*NOTICE* The current state of the F2P core may present with edge cases and minor bugs but we wanted to start growing the community and gaining priority from the VR playerbase sooner rather than later in this process.


Into the future:

1) DLC content is planned and currently in early stages of development and testing.
2) The following gamemodes are planned to be part of this release.
- Deathmatch
- Team Deathmatch
- Heist
- Tower Defense

3) Dedicated servers and Battle Royale (currently about 35% into development) will continue development in addition to the above milestones.

********PLEASE NOTE*******
We are a very small developer team but as our work ethic has shown this will not detour us from delivering an above all else "FUN" experience! As development progresses please consider that things are subject to change and milestones may be moved around. Our inspiration and motivation comes from you! So again … Thank you!

We also owe a great deal of gratitude to Mordentral and the group of developers within the UE4 VRE community. Awesome group of people who have supported us along this journey!

Jason - WildOx Studios
Tim - TiMer Games
